Name: MH Event List
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Event List[/center][/b][/size][b][center][/center][/b]
A comprehensive event management and discovery tool for Stardew Valley. Browse, filter, and track all game events with an intuitive interface. Perfect for completionists who want to ensure they don't miss any character interactions or story moments.

[b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with vanilla and modded events[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Filtering and search system
[list]
[*]Filter by character/NPC with heart level control (0-14 hearts)
[*]View Available, All Events, Seen Events, CP or Hidden events
[*]Filter by relationship events only
[*]Search across event IDs, locations, and conditions
[*]Sort by ID, Location, Mods, or Hearts (ascending/descending)
[/list][*]Detailed event information
[list]
[*]View all event preconditions and their current status
[*]See required NPCs, locations, and heart levels
[*]Complete condition codes legend, I think they're all of them :)
[*]Mark events as seen/unseen manually
[*]Identify invalid or null event scripts
[/list][*]Quality of life features
[list]
[*]Quick warp to event locations
[*]Force play any event for testing
[*]Debug logging for mod developers
[*]Hide/show individual events
[*]Dark and light theme support
[/list][*]Customization options
[list]
[*]Configurable keybindings
[*]Toggle button visibility (warp, debug, play event)
[*]24-hour or 12-hour time format
[*]Hide events from unseen locations
[/list][/list]

[size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size][list]
[*]﻿Press F7 (or your configured key) to open the MH Event List panel
[*]﻿You can view all events with different filters and from here see all their details, go to their location and trigger the event manually if you wish.
[/list]

[size=5][b]Event Conditions
[/b][/size]
The mod displays all event preconditions and checks them in real-time. A green checkmark (OK) means the condition is met, while a red means it's not yet satisfied. The legend explains what each condition code means (friendship, time, weather, items, etc.).

[b]Notes
[/b]If you use the options to force an event or go to the location, you may be able to appear off the map or stuck. So it is recommended to have a mod that allows you to move out of the map or transport yourself again as NoClip


[b][size=5]Credits
[/size][/b]
Based on concepts from Event Lookup by shekurika - thanks for the inspiration!
